cohort: Women aged ≥45 at delivery between March 2011 and January 2018 and women aged <35 at delivery with twin pregnancies that conceived by IVF
finding: Twin pregnancies in women aged 45 and older are associated with a significantly higher risk of complications such as preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm delivery, and fetal growth restriction compared to singleton pregnancies at the same age and twin pregnancies in younger women.
mod_finding: Women in the fifth and sixth decades with twins had higher rates of cesarean deliveries (91.8% vs. 56.4%, p<0.001) compared to younger women carrying twins.
